overview: Synthetic Zambia demonstration for ten vaccine refrigerators under matrix_demo_001 with C-01 Technical capability weight 60 and C-02 Delivery plan weight 40. Compared two admitted bidders on same basis using full bid texts. Demo Clinic Supplies documents specification, named technicians and 30-day milestones. Demo Medical Works documents specification only and states no service team and no signed schedule.

recommendation.basis: Demo Clinic Supplies shows the strongest documented fit with SUPPORTED evidence on both C-01 and C-02 in supplied text, while Demo Medical Works is PARTIAL on C-01 and NOT_EVIDENCED on C-02 and has a recorded administratively nonresponsive context. Advisory comparison only for committee verification and scoring; not an award decision.
